aggregate_utility.unit: environment by pass, averaged across the two frozen training seeds and 25 development targets
aggregate_utility.definition: Starting-checkpoint mean frequency MAE minus trained-checkpoint mean frequency MAE in THz; positive values indicate improvement.
aggregate_utility.budget: completed equal-cost passes over one 50000-atom, 2100000-edge environment
aggregate_utility.response_surface: Four pass-specific intercepts plus s(pass) times standardized environment coordinates, where s(pass)=pass/(pass+1).
aggregate_utility.standardization: Fit mean and population standard deviation inside each training fold.
aggregate_utility.cross_validation: Leave one complete development environment out, preserving both seeds and all checkpoints inside the held-out unit.
aggregate_utility.selection_rule: Select the candidate with the lowest leave-one-environment-out curve RMSE. Break exact ties by higher pairwise rank accuracy, then lower allocation regret, then fewer coordinates.
aggregate_utility.uncertainty: Calibrate a curve-level empirical envelope from each held-out environment's maximum absolute residual and report observed two-seed differences separately.

primary_label.name: frequency_error_regression
primary_label.definition: The seed-mean commensurate-phonon frequency MAE exceeds 1.05 times the starting-checkpoint MAE for the same material.
primary_label.rationale: The five-percent boundary matches the practical-equivalence band fixed for starting-checkpoint qualification.

secondary_labels.name: stability_regression
secondary_labels.definition: The starting checkpoint classifies dynamical stability correctly and a majority of prespecified training seeds classify it incorrectly.

secondary_labels.name: validity_regression
secondary_labels.definition: The starting checkpoint completes the released phonon workflow and a majority of prespecified training seeds fail it.

target_regressions.seed_aggregation: Two-seed mean for frequency error; majority rule for binary stability and validity endpoints.
target_regressions.estimator: L2-regularized logistic regression with penalty strengths 0.1, 1, and 10 selected inside each outer training fold.
target_regressions.primary_cross_validation: Leave one complete development environment out.
secondary_cross_validation: leave one target element set out
target_regressions.selection_rule: Select the candidate with the lowest leave-one-environment-out Brier score. Break exact ties by higher average precision, then higher ROC AUC, then fewer features.

prospective_freeze.aggregate: Serialize four curves, rankings, uncertainty, and the selected environment at every pass.
prospective_freeze.regressions: Serialize one probability for each of 200 prospective environment-target pairs before prospective training.
prospective_freeze.authorization: Prospective training requires a separate artifact that binds this protocol, selected models, predictions, and the final training contract.
